days.note: A short west-face line at 4 pitches; approach into the basin, climb up to join the upper Beckey Route area, then rappel/downclimb the standard line to the Liberty Bell-Concord notch and out.
days.title: Short car-to-car day climb
days.objective: Climb Rapple Grapple to the Liberty Bell-Concord notch

itinerary.totalNote: A short single day, roughly 8 hrs car-to-car.

pitch_detail.notes: Shares its first pitch with the Beckey Route: a low-fifth-class traverse and chimney past ledges and small trees to a belay at the base of a steeper chimney.
Traverses right along the 'Beckey ledge' past a few trees into an open-book corner with good 5.7 finger and hand cracks — the route's namesake harder alternative to the standard Beckey line.
Rejoins the Beckey Route near the top of the buttress for a final short scramble and 5.6 friction slab to the summit.
